name: PickleBlast
subtitle: Pickleball Boss Rally on Watch
description:
Take the court on Apple Watch. Turn the Digital Crown to move, meet the incoming ball, and your player returns it automatically. You can also drag across the court. Placement comes from where you meet the ball, with no wrist swinging required.

BOSS RALLY
Challenge The Wall, The Banger, and The Poacher. Each opponent has a different approach: steady coverage, a powerful drive, or a committed step toward the ball. Play an individual match or choose All Three to face Wall, Banger, then Poacher in order. Matches are first to three points, with two free saves per match.

ARCADE
Break through three waves of targets, build consecutive-hit multipliers, and face The Wall in the finale. Three lives carry through the run, and each stage gives you two free recoveries.

MADE FOR APPLE WATCH
Adjust Crown sensitivity and haptics in Settings. Pause, resume, restart, or return Home. Your Arcade best and opponent records stay on your Watch. Gameplay works offline, with no account, phone companion, ads, or in-app purchases.

Requires watchOS 10 or later. Privacy and support information are available in Settings, including an offline privacy policy.
promotional_text: Face The Wall, The Banger, and The Poacher in Boss Rally, or break through Arcade waves. Move with the Digital Crown; returns are automatic.
